scope: D15-4 real native subagent/fork continuity qualification against the fixed DSH 0.1.5rc1 candidate. Not D15-5/D15-G; not R3.
llm_evidence_note: A keyless scripted in-process adapter drives the real candidate agent loop, session persistence and subagent providers. This is runtime-continuity evidence, NOT real-LLM-quality semantic evidence.

required_scenarios.description: the continuable child is a distinct durable SessionId whose header records the exact live direct parent; the child is never the parent identity
the versioned subagent/descriptor with mode=continuable is persisted before the first turn
a genuinely new OS process cold-resumes the same durable child from its descriptor with a contiguous log and exactly one settlement
the fork provider yields a distinct child seeded with the parent's balanced completed-turn prefix (exact cut) and leaves the full parent log byte-identical and the same length
declared provider/model/reasoning-effort/persona are persisted in the descriptor and reapplied on cold resume
SIGKILL of the owning executor process preserves the durable parent identity and the child stays natively resumable with no fabricated completion
a child-only SIGKILL while the parent is alive; truthfully interrupted and natively resumed
a real isolated BYQ runtime-adapter container restart rebinding a BYQ-delegated continuable child

optional_scenarios.description: supporting evidence (not a substitute for child-crash): a real independent child-run fault (the child's model stream fails) while the parent process stays alive; the child id is retained, the parent settlement is truthful and the child is natively resumable in a later OS process.
host reboot. NOT executed: rebooting the maintainer host is not authorized and a container/adapter restart is not a host reboot.

fail_closed: required scenario not covered by a PASS (BLOCKED/NOT_RUN/FAIL/MISSING do not pass)
required PASS with a false assertion
required PASS without fault_applied when the contract requires a fault
a negative that was not rejected
missing measured settlement count (not defaulted to pass)
a descriptor or format-layer artifact alone
any attempt by the observation to declare its own continuity/coverage rules

notes.native_seam: the native continuable seam is driven by an evidence-only harness; BYQ must not persist subagent state and no second generic harness or R3 behaviour is built
notes.host_reboot: kept separate from container/adapter restart and NOT_RUN in this batch
notes.blocked_items: child-crash and byq-adapter-restart are required but unreachable in this batch; they stay BLOCKED with their reason and gate the overall verdict
